content:
B"H

# COMPLETED_WORK

## Production short

- Created `The Emergency Backup Spoon`, an original exact sixty-second office sitcom.
- Authored three acts, three reusable neutral identities, nine spoken lines, ten camera shots, two title cards, two text boxes, deterministic phoneme/viseme cues, gaze, blink, emotion, lean, locked crossed arms, locked pocket contact, open palm, point, present, and all five gesture phases.
- Compiled the source plan into the native NLE timeline and title track.

## Character and renderer completion

- Added a render-only adapter that preserves neutral reference identity separately from performance state.
- Added readable palms, thumbs, fingers, points, fists, grips, and pocket contact.
- Added heel, toe, sole, and view-direction shoe geometry.
- Added coat/skirt weight and restrained secondary motion.
- Added locked-contact gesture geometry independent of locomotion phase.
- Added title-card and timed text-box production consumers.
- Unified preview and final export through `CinematicFrameRenderer`.
- Added canonical 640×360 stage-to-viewport mapping so production characters remain visible at all proof dimensions.

## Persistence and export

- Added exact short-form schema validation.
- Proved JSON restoration of identities, dialogue cues, overlays, timeline, and custom authored state.
- Proved project-package sanitation excludes runtime caches, canvas/context state, functions, Blob URLs, and `_stablePose`.
- Replaced the fake block-based one-minute exporter with a real three-character H.264/AAC exporter.
- Generated synthesized dialogue, 720 production frames, final MP4, 15-second preview, source plan, EDL, dialogue data, title/text data, audio manifest, FFprobe report, proof frames, scale courts, and hashes.

## Verification

- Added focused plan, performance, persistence, metadata, and scale-court tests.
- Added the focused short gate to the official `npm run verify` chain.
- Ran the complete repository verification successfully.
- Audited all 32 touched JavaScript files for headers, tabs, line count, JSDoc, syntax, and whitespace.
